name: spike
description: Time-boxed research: answer a question, write it up, decide. Produces a wiki page, not production code.

steps.title: Question + exit criteria: {title}
steps.body: One sentence question. What answer would change a decision? Time box stated.

steps.title: Investigate: {title}
steps.body: Findings as evidence events on this ticket. Dead ends recorded too — they are answers.

steps.title: Write-up: {title}
steps.body: Wiki page: findings, confidence, what would falsify. Link from this ticket.

steps.title: Decide: adopt / adapt / drop
steps.body: Decision event on the root with rationale. Converts into a feature ticket if adopt.
